subject: MAP draft: Data handling & compliance follow-up
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@medidatahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 22:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP draft: Data handling & compliance follow-up

Hi Michael \u2014 thanks again for the call today. Sending a short post-call recap and next steps on the MAP milestone that covers data handling and compliance. Attached is the initial MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v1.xlsx) with the milestone row filled out; see highlights below.

Summary (action items / timeline):
- Milestone: Data handling & compliance (retention, logging, audit trails, PHI/PII constraints)
- Target completion: 2026-04-15 (integration & evidence submission)
- Redwood owner: Aditya Rao (AE) / Marissa Cole (Security lead)
- Customer owner: Michael Chen (Data Platform) / Priya Singh (Security)
- Dependencies: Customer SOC2 report + sample audit logs export format; network connectivity for log export (SFTP / cloud bucket); PHI scoping confirmation

High-level asks for next week:
1) Michael/Priya: confirm whether workloads will include PHI and approximate retention windows required per dataset (e.g., 30/90/365 days).
2) If SOC2 available, please share the latest report or point us to where we can validate controls.
3) Agree on preferred log export mechanism (SFTP vs. GCS/Azure blob) so we can include it in the MAP.

I've added a checklist in the MAP sheet and left comments where we need specific inputs from your security team. If helpful, Marissa can join a short 30-min follow-up with your security lead to walk through the requirements.

Next steps:
- Michael: reply with PHI confirmation + SOC2 availability (by end of week)
- Aditya/Marissa: update MAP and prepare the data-handling evidence list
- Schedule: follow-up security call (TBD)

Thanks \u2014
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (draft)

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@medidatahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@medidatahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2026 09:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Data handling & compliance follow-up

Aditya \u2014 thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few clarifications from our side:

- PHI: yes, some datasets will contain limited PHI (patient IDs, encounter dates). We need to treat those as regulated. I can provide a scoped list of fields by Thursday.
- Retention: baseline retention request is 365 days for most analytic logs; some operational traces can be 90 days. We may need configurable retention per dataset.
- SOC2: we have a SOC2 Type II report (2025) \u2014 I can share a redacted copy with access via our vendor portal.
- Log export: prefer GCS bucket to start (we use GCP). We can provide a service account with write access to a specific bucket.

Question: for audit trails, do you support exporting raw request logs including full request/response payloads, or only metadata-level logs (request ID, timestamp, model, tokens)? For HIPAA/PHI reasons, we may prefer metadata-only exports and not store full text for PHI-labeled requests.

Happy to schedule the security sync. I included Priya (security) on this thread.

\u0014Michael
Michael Chen
Head of Data Platform | Medidata Health
michael.chen@medidatahealth.com | +1 (718) 555-2481

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Chen <michael.chen@medidatahealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@medidatahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2026 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Data handling & compliance follow-up

Michael \u2014 great, thanks for the quick answers. I updated the MAP (attached) with your preferred GCS export and provisional retention windows. A few answers to your question and next steps:

- Audit log content: Redwood can export both metadata-level logs (request id, model, response token count, timestamp, route, customer-provided request id) and full request/response payloads. For PHI-sensitive workloads we recommend:
  - Default: metadata-only export to your GCS bucket
  - Optional: full payload export controlled by a flagged route and customer opt-in; Redwood can also redact or mask PII fields before storage if you provide the field list to mask

- Controls & evidence: we can provide (1) SOC2 summary and relevant control mappings, (2) example log export files (CSV/JSON stub), (3) redaction config example. I've attached data_handling_requirements.pdf with the evidence list and example formats.

- Proposed MAP milestone row (summary):
  - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (Security) \u2014 provides evidence and config
  - Owner (Customer): Priya Singh \u2014 confirms PHI scope and provides SOC2 access + SVC account
  - Dependencies: SOC2 report, GCS write access, list of PHI fields for redaction, retention policy confirmation
  - Target complete: 2026-04-15

Can we aim to have Priya share the SOC2 link and the PHI scope by Thu 12 Mar? If yes, I'll lock the MAP milestone and loop in our security team. If you'd like to expedite, Marissa is available for a 30-min sync on Thu 12 Mar at 16:00 UTC \u2014 propose that slot if it works.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), data_handling_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@medidatahealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@medidatahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2026 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Data handling & compliance follow-up

Thanks \u2014 adding a short security checklist here for clarity. Michael / Priya: copying the items that we'd need to mark the milestone complete.

Security checklist (evidence we require):
- SOC2 Type II (latest) or vendor portal access (PDF acceptable)
- Example log export (redacted) in target GCS format (JSON/CSV) \u2014 include request_id, timestamp, model, route, and example payload if permitted
- Redaction mapping: list of fields to mask/redact for PHI datasets + example of expected behavior
- Retention policy confirmation per dataset (e.g., analytics: 365d; traces: 90d)
- SLA/contract note: confirm that retention/export terms will be included in the SOW/contract (we'll surface the clause)
- Access controls: list of accounts that will have read access to exported logs and expected rotation policy for service account keys

Operational notes:
- For metadata-only export we will never persist full request bodies to our long-term logs unless explicitly enabled per-route.
- If requested, we can provide a short engineering runbook describing how to configure route-level redaction and export automation.

Priya \u2014 can you share the SOC2 link and PHI field list by EOD Thu 12 Mar? If you prefer, we can take the runbook and work with your infra team directly to validate the GCS write.

I'll prepare the final MAP row once we have those items and then send a DocuSign-ready SOW appendix describing the retention/export terms.

Best \u2014
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@medidatahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2026 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP draft: Data handling & compliance follow-up

Marissa / Aditya \u2014 thanks for the checklist and the updated MAP. Priya and I confirmed the following:
- SOC2: portal link sent to Marissa (secured link) \u2014 please confirm receipt
- PHI scope: we'll share the field list by EOD Thu 12 Mar; initial list includes patient_id, mrn, dob, encounter_date
- GCS: we will provision a write-only service account to the bucket and share the key/iam permissions once the sync is scheduled

The Thu 12 Mar 16:00 UTC slot works for Priya and me. Please send calendar invite and we'll have our infra/security engineer join.

Look forward to locking the MAP milestone and moving to SOW language.

\u0014Michael
